Request for quotation · supply, installation and commissioning

Commercial kitchen equipment for quotation

Konso Garden · dim sum and craft beer pub · kitchen, dish wash, bar and store room · Cavelossim, Goa

The project

A 40-cover restaurant (an open-sided hall with a bar) with a kitchen block beside it: kitchen, dish wash, store room and washroom. The menu is dim sum, bao, noodles, wok dishes and small plates. Cooking is on LPG: wok, stock range, fryer and steamer under one hood. There is no dishwasher, ice machine or glass washer at the start; hand wash in sinks.

What we ask you to quote

Supply, delivery, installation, connection and commissioning of the equipment in the schedule (section 3), to the sizes in millimetres (W × D × H), placed as in the drawings (section 4). Please price every line on the price form (section 7) and answer the questions in section 8.

Three parts. Parts A, B and C (kitchen, ventilation and gas, dish wash) are the core order. Parts D and E (bar fittings, store racking) and F (extras) are optional: price them separately so we can accept or drop them.
In numbers. 12 kitchen lines, 5 ventilation and gas lines, 10 dish-wash lines; kitchen room 4,100 × 4,180 mm clear; dish wash 5,210 × 1,800 mm clear; one hood, one duct, one roof fan.

How to quote

  1. Price every line of section 7. Mark any line you cannot supply and offer an alternative with a photo and data sheet.
  2. For each item give make, model, actual outside dimensions, electrical load (kW) and gas consumption (kg/h), and warranty.
  3. Quote supply and installation separately, GST shown separately.
  4. Quote Parts D, E and F separately.
  5. Give a lead time per line and an installation programme.
  6. Visit the site before quoting. Sizes marked to confirm are not measured.

2 · Site conditions and services

AreaSize and conditions
Kitchen4,100 (east–west) × 4,180 (north–south) mm clear. Temporary wall on the east side that cannot be removed. Entry through a 800 mm door at the north end of the west wall. A white-painted timber and plywood partition (about 2,200 high, existing) forms a 1,950 mm store passage in the south-east corner, with a 900 mm door-less opening on its west face and a 900 mm store door in the kitchen south wall. One existing sink (K28), north-east corner. Floor to fall 1:100 to a hot-line trough. Sloping ceiling about 2,600–3,000 mm (to confirm).
Dish wash5,410 × 2,000 mm wall to wall; 5,210 × 1,800 mm clear. 1,170 mm west doorway (no door yet). East end: a 2,000 mm cell (existing partition) holding the existing 500 L overhead tank and the two sinks D2 and D3. Existing floor drain grating D11 (1,300 × 350). Flat ceiling about 3,000 mm (to confirm). Louvred window in the north wall.
Store room2,700 × 6,460 mm wall to wall, 2,500 × 6,260 clear. Door from the kitchen. Racks 500 deep on both sides of a 1,460 mm aisle. Two windows on the east wall, door grille. No water or drain.
BarCounter 2,650 mm long; 1,300 mm clear aisle behind it; back bar 2,650 mm; ceiling 2,180 above floor. Existing wooden work slab and bar sink.
Access for deliveriesLargest units: K6/K7 (1,200 × 800 × 1,950), hood K5 (2,600 and 2,500 long legs), D13 (2,100 long). Entry doors are 800 mm (kitchen) and 1,170 mm (dish wash). Hood, duct and any unit that will not pass an 800 mm door must be supplied knocked down or in sections: tell us.
EnvironmentCoastal Goa: salt air, high humidity most of the year, monsoon June to September, ants and geckos. Use stainless steel, tropical-rated refrigeration (43 °C ambient), stainless fixings, sealed joints.
ServicesLPG in 4 × 19 kg cylinders (2 working, 2 standby) in a cage outside the east wall of the store room; gas pipe from there to the kitchen. Electricity 230 V, 50 Hz, single phase, about 10–14 kW connected for the whole block (client’s estimate; to confirm with the electrician). Water from an existing 500 L overhead tank; 50 L heater D5 in the dish wash. One drain line (100 mm) from the kitchen and dish wash through the east wall to a grease trap outside, then the outfall (outfall point not yet known: to confirm).

6 · Inclusions, exclusions and commercial terms

Included in your price

  • Supply, delivery to site, off-loading, positioning, levelling and fixing of all listed items.
  • Hood, duct, fan, make-up louvre, dampers, supports, flashing at the roof.
  • Gas pipe inside the building, valves, leak detector, solenoid, pressure test and certificate.
  • Final plumbing and electrical connections at each unit.
  • Testing, commissioning, a short staff training and the operating manuals.
  • Warranty (minimum 12 months on equipment, 24 on stainless fabrication), with service contact for Goa.

Excluded (client or others)

  • Civil, masonry, plastering, tiling and floor falls; cutting of the pass hatch opening.
  • Main electrical supply, distribution board, earthing.
  • Water tank, main water pipe, drains beyond the unit connection, grease trap, inspection chamber.
  • LPG cylinders, regulators and the cylinder cage (gas supplier).
  • Fire-suppression system, extinguishers (unless priced as option OP1).
  • Smallwares, crockery and glassware (unless priced as Annex 1).
  • KDS screens, POS and IT; doors K30 and D14; bins; mortar K16; coffee brewer and urn.

Commercial terms to state

  • Price validity, payment schedule (advance, on delivery, on commissioning).
  • Delivery period per line and installation duration on site.
  • GST rate by line; freight; insurance; transit damage cover.
  • Warranty period and who services in Goa; spare parts availability.
  • Samples or visit to a working installation, if available.
  • Alternatives: where a cheaper or smaller unit does the same job, please offer it as an alternative line.

Stainless steel standard

AISI 304 for everything touching food or water, unless stated. State thickness of sheet for each fabricated item. Welds ground and polished. Rounded corners, no open seams, adjustable stainless feet (150 mm off the floor).

Gas and fire safety

All gas appliances to have flame-failure devices. Work to the applicable Indian standards and the local fire and FSSAI requirements; the client’s consultant will confirm the Goa-specific rules.

8 · Open points and questions for the vendor

Not yet confirmed by the client (we will confirm after the site visit)

  • Exact store-door position in the kitchen south wall (drawn 2,650–3,550 from the west wall) and the pass-hatch position.
  • Ceiling and clear heights in the kitchen and dish wash (about 2,600–3,000 mm) and the roof construction at the fan position.
  • Size of the kitchen sink K28 and of the 500 L tank (assumed), and whether the tank bracket takes 500 L.
  • Where the drain outfall goes (sewer, septic tank or soak pit) and the position of the grease trap.
  • Gas bank position and distances required by the supplier and Goa fire rules (not yet checked); pipe length is therefore an estimate.
  • The partition K31 is timber and plywood and not fire-rated: the fire consultant will say if the cooking line may sit beside it.

Questions for you

  1. Do the actual overall sizes of your units match the schedule? List every difference.
  2. For K6/K7: can you supply a unit that passes through an 800 mm door, or knock-down?
  3. Hood K5 (L-shaped, one collar at the corner): your airflow, static pressure, fan kW, duct size and the roof exit detail.
  4. Will you supply and fit the hot-line trough Y1 and the floor grating (we assume the civil contractor does)?
  5. Which fire-suppression system do you recommend under the hood, and at what price (option OP1)?
  6. The dim sum steamer K4 is limited to 550 mm wide: which models fit, gas or electric?
  7. Power load of all items together, to confirm single-phase is enough.
  8. Lead time, installation days and the order in which you need the site ready (civil, plumbing, power, gas).
  9. References: two restaurant kitchens you have installed in Goa or on the west coast.
